sources.title: samuelolubukun/xtts-v2-hausa-openbible · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model extends XTTS-v2's multilingual voice-cloning capabilities to Hausa, maintaining conditioning latents, speaker cloning fidelity, and cross-lingual transfer from a reference audio clip (3 to 10 seconds).
